purpose: Exploratory pilot-informed prompt sensitivity under one attempt; no hidden-state knowledge, method superiority, stochastic independence or held-out task generalization claim.
order: profile blocks v1 then v2, cases in declared order
sampling: one run per case/profile, same trial seed0 and phase keys0/1 across all cases; repeats are controls, not independent tasks
interpretation: One attempt suppresses retry differences. Report claim/abstention/partial counts and coverage with hindsight alignment; visible evidence can be identical across different hidden outcomes.
failure_handling: Retain failures and unknowns; no redraws or replacement samples. Preflight failure is separate from completed episodes.
payment_scope: Synthetic isolated payments; local Ollama only.
